title: Oracle Morning Brief
script_summary:
Bitcoin holds at 63,250 after a 1% overnight lift while Fear and Greed stays deep in fear at 27. Hashrate remains firm at 776 EH/s, showing miners are not backing off.

Asia session added modest buying pressure with no major liquidations reported. Mempool sits at 93,000 transactions yet fees are pinned at 2 sat/vB, keeping on-chain costs negligible.

Watch for a push above 64k today. Any sustained move could flip sentiment quickly as block 957,021 advances the chain.
